description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB_Encrypt_MCrypt' that manages encryption and decryption using the mcrypt extension, including methods for setting cipher, mode, and source, as well as writing and reading encrypted data.

classes.name: ADODB_Encrypt_MCrypt
classes.description: A class providing encryption and decryption functionalities using the mcrypt extension in PHP.

methods.name: getCipher
methods.description: Returns the current cipher used for encryption.

methods.name: setCipher
methods.description: Sets the cipher to be used for encryption.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the current mode of operation for encryption.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of operation for encryption.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source for random data generation.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source for random data generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cipher, mode, and source with optional parameters or defaults.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encrypts data using the specified key and current cipher/mode.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Decrypts data using the specified key and current cipher/mode.
